messages.content: Where is my order #A54321?
Your order #A54321 was shipped on April 10th via FedEx. It's currently in transit and is expected to arrive on April 14th.
I need to change my shipping address.
Sure! If your order hasn’t shipped yet, we can update your address. Please provide your new shipping details.
What does 'Processing' mean on my order status?
'Processing' means we’ve received your order and are preparing it for shipment. You’ll get an update when it’s packed.
How do I return an item I received yesterday?
You can initiate a return by visiting your order history and clicking 'Return Item.' Please include the reason and select a pickup or drop-off option.
Why did I get charged twice for one item?
Sometimes temporary holds may appear as duplicate charges. Please allow 1–2 business days. If both remain, we’ll issue a refund.
Can I get a PDF invoice for my last order?
Of course. We’ve emailed the invoice to your registered address. You can also download it from your account under 'Order History'.
What courier do you use for deliveries in Toronto?
We partner with Canada Post and UPS for Toronto deliveries. You’ll receive a tracking number once the item ships.
My order is late. It was supposed to arrive two days ago.
Sorry for the delay! Your order was shipped on time but may be delayed due to weather. We’ll reach out to the courier and update you shortly.
I ordered 2 items but only received one.
Thanks for letting us know. Sometimes items ship separately. We’ll check the tracking and notify you of the second item’s status.
Can I cancel my order?
If your order hasn’t been packed yet, we can cancel it. Please confirm your order ID so we can proceed.
What happens after my payment is confirmed?
Once payment is confirmed, your order moves to 'Processing,' where we pick and pack your items before shipping.
Please summarize this email: 'Order #90342 confirmed. Shipping to 145 Queen St. E. Estimated delivery: April 15.'
Your order #90342 has been confirmed and will be shipped to 145 Queen St. E., expected to arrive by April 15.
Do you offer express shipping?
Yes! We offer express delivery via DHL and FedEx. You can select this option during checkout for faster service.
My item arrived damaged. What do I do?
We’re sorry to hear that. Please upload a photo of the damaged item and we’ll arrange a free replacement or refund.
Can I place an order without creating an account?
Yes! You can check out as a guest, but we recommend creating an account to track orders and earn rewards.
How long does fulfillment take?
Fulfillment typically takes 1–2 business days. You’ll be notified once your order is shipped.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes, we ship to over 50 countries. International delivery takes 7–14 business days depending on location.
Why was my order canceled?
Your order may have been canceled due to payment issues or stock availability. Check your email for details or contact support.
How do I know if an item is in stock?
If the item is available to add to your cart, it’s in stock. For out-of-stock items, you can sign up for a restock alert.
What’s the difference between 'Shipped' and 'Out for delivery'?
'Shipped' means the package left our warehouse. 'Out for delivery' means the courier has it and it’s on its way to your address today.
